description: PowerSAS.m is an open-source software package listed in best-of-ps, a ranked list of open-source power-system-analysis projects under the section "phasor / electro-mechanical transient simulation", published or maintained by ANL-CEEESA (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). Power grid analysis framework based on semi-analytical solutions. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "phasor / electro-mechanical transient simulation". Implementation language: Octave, MATLAB. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is BSD-3-Clause (as given in the list). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system stability and dynamics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-best-of-ps.
